text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer isn't feeling well, so I take her to the infirmary…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer. A little snooze and I'll be good as new… Probably, anyway! See you later!

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: Welcome, one and all. I hope you're all having a good time.

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: For our next event, we have prepared a special game of tag for you to enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Tag? At a party?

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: The rules are quite simple. All you must do is escape from the large number of monsters we will be letting loose in the venue.

text_block_list.name: Gadfly Monster
text_block_list.text: Smack, smack! Hungy! Food!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, those gadflies are mega-sized! Just looking at them is making my skin itch and burn!

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: Make it outside before time expires, and victory is yours! Ready… Go!

text_block_list.name: Gadfly Monster
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ack! Here they come! All-out sprinting's not gonna be enough to get away from them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But if it's one thing I have full confidence in, it's my ability to run away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No matter the dilemma I'm facing, I always get away!

text_block_list.name: Gadfly Monster
text_block_list.text: BWAAAH?! BRAGH?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That was sure a dream and a half…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But that running style wasn't half bad… I think I'll try it out in my next training session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer has a bizarre dream, but getting to run fast and free in it helps lift her spirits, allowing her to go back to her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Gadfly Monster
text_block_list.text: You planning to go all out, huh? Guess I'll call everyone over, then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh, who's "everyone"?

text_block_list.name: Gadfly Monster
text_block_list.text: Great-Grandpappy! Great-Great-Grandmama! Uncle, aunties, and everyone else! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Gadfly Monster
text_block_list.text: Dinner's seeerved!

text_block_list.name: Gadfly Monster Family
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: …Agh! It was just a dream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aw geez… Time to up my training so no gadflies can ever catch me, either in my dreams or real life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After having such a strange dream, Mejiro Palmer's condition remains as poor as before…
